name: Blogmentor – Blog Layouts for Elementor
author: AuburnForest

sections.description:
Blogmentor is an elementor add-on to showcase your WordPress posts in beautiful way. This is an simple and flexible way to decorate your WordPress posts with the help of Elementor page builder.

View Demo

3 Blog Posts Layouts

We have designed 3 of the most useful blog layouts to climb the top of your design capabilities.

  1. Grid Layout – 2 different styles available
  2. Masonry Layout – 2 different styles available
  3. Metro Layout – 1 style available
  4. Many more coming soon …

Documentation and Support

  • If you have any more questions, visit our support on the Plugin’s Forum.

Note: This plugin is a widget of Elementor Page Builder and will only work with Elementor Page Builder installed.

Like Blogmentor Plugin?

  • Don’t forget to rate us on WordPress 🙂

Credits

This plugin bundles a minified build of Font Awesome Free v7.3.1 (icons: CC BY 4.0, fonts: SIL OFL 1.1, code: MIT License). Full source and build tools are maintained at the linked repository.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/plugin-name directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
sections.faq:
Can I add multiple Blogmentor with single page?

Yes, you can. Blogmentor plugin gives you the ability to add multiple Blog Posts on same page. You just need to drag and drop that module multiple times and select different post styles whatever you want.

Can I change color or customize post style as per my wish?

Yes, You can customize it. We provided all possible options in backend to update it from default blog posts widget options.

Release Date: August 21st, 2026

  • [Updated] Latest WordPress 7.1 compatibility check
  • Verified against a full PHPCS/WPCS scan (WordPress, WordPress-Extra, WordPress-Docs standards) and WordPress.org Plugin Check with zero findings beyond this readme update

1.6.1

Release Date: August 7th, 2026

  • [Changed] Raised minimum required PHP version to 7.4, matching WordPress core’s own minimum as of WordPress 7.0
  • [Changed] Updated bundled Font Awesome from v5.2.0 to v7.3.1 (solid icon set only)
  • [Security] Removed a direct link to the 5-star filtered reviews page in the admin review-request notice, per WordPress.org guidelines
  • [Fixed] Synced the plugin header name with the readme.txt listing title
  • [Fixed] Corrected readme.txt “Tested up to” to a major.minor version
  • [Fixed] Prefixed all global constants, functions, and template-local variables with blogmentor_/BLOGMENTOR_ (previously bm_/BM_) to avoid naming collisions with other plugins
  • [Fixed] Prefixed all registered/enqueued style and script handles with blogmentor- to avoid collisions with other plugins/themes
  • [Fixed] Made “Summary” / “Full Text” post content feed options translatable
  • [Fixed] Replaced blank/placeholder (“Cherry plant”) image alt text with a meaningful, translatable “Default Post Image” description
  • [Improved] Coding standards cleanup: normalized CRLF line endings to LF across 8 files (PHPCS/WPCS)
  • [Improved] Regenerated languages/blogmentor.pot translation template
